title: Chihayafuru
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chihaya Ayase discovers competitive karuta, a card game based on the classical poetry anthology Hyakunin Isshu, through her classmate Arata (to verify). In high school she founds a karuta club with her childhood friend Taichi and others, aiming to become Queen while a long love triangle unfolds (to verify).
life_message: It holds up passion pursued with discipline, loyalty to teammates and love for a living cultural tradition.
